| Metric | Price | Unit |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Input | $30 | 1M tokens |
| Output | $180 | 1M tokens |

- GPT-5.5 Pro does not offer a cached input discount.
sources.supports: OpenAI's official GPT-5.5 Pro page lists the same $30 input and $180 output base prices, with no cached input discount.

sources.quote:
| Model | Short context input | Short context cached input | Short context cache writes | Short context output | Long context input | Long context cached input | Long context cache writes | Long context output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gpt-5.5-pro (<272K context length) | $30.00 | - | - | $180.00 | $60.00 | - | - | $270.00 |
sources.supports: OpenAI publishes both the base and higher long-context price for GPT-5.5 Pro; the long-context rate is tied to context length, demonstrating tiered pricing rather than a general price change.

notes: The evidence indicates the $30/$180 rates were the official base rates; the later-added higher tier reflects omitted long-context pricing. OpenAI's current documentation sets its threshold at 272K context length, not the 200,000-token cutoff in the models.dev record, and the sources do not establish when ZenMux reflected that tier.
